Competition Rules
⏰ Weekly Picks
  • ► Picks must be submitted between Friday 00:00 and Saturday 14:59
  • ► If no pick is submitted you pass that week — no points awarded
  • ► Maximum of 6 picks per team over the season — draw picks are unlimited
  • ► Your weekly picked result cannot be the same team or result as another player who picked before you — you cannot pick the same game but a different winner
